description:
Generate several animations in one job. Two ways to use it:
1. A PRESET on one sprite: platformer-character (idle, run, jump, attack-1, death, hurt) or a top-down set (topdown-walk/run/dash/attack: 8 directions; topdown-idle: 4). Each item gets the preset's actions.
2. A PRESET across an 8-way rotation set: one item per facing, {assetId, frameIndex:<rotation frame id>, imageIndex:i} where i is the facing's position in the frame's facings list, and every facing gets its own directional clip (walk-left from the left-facing image, …). If the facings list has no 'down' (the sprite was drawn facing the camera), add {assetId, base:true} as 'down'. If it already has 'down' (a side-view sprite), use only the rotation's own images: the base is the side view, not the front. For topdown-idle pick only the 4 cardinals (down, right, up, left).
Without a preset, list the actions in the prompt for up to 6 custom clips, one clip each: 'name: description' separated by semicolons names each clip (e.g. 'attack-2: an overhead slash; block: raise the sword to guard'); for one image a plain 'idle, run, jump' also works. Every image gets every action. Cost: 100 credits per pass (200 for 1024px sprites, which run in 4K); a pass holds up to 6 clips. On an 8-way rotation set the left, up-left and down-left clips are mirrored from the right-side ones (the rotation's left side is a mirror already), so an 8-way set is ONE pass; set flipFacings false to animate all eight (2 passes). Clips are added to their source asset as frames named after the action.

autoFlip.description: After the run, mirror every right-side clip on the asset that has no left twin (animate only the right-facing turns, get all eight). Free

flipFacings.description: On an 8-way rotation set, mirror the left-side clips from the right-side ones instead of animating them (half the price). One-sided details swap sides, as on the rotation images

holdFacing.description: End every clip on the frame it started from, so directional loops do not drift

base.description: true = the asset's original base image, counted as the 'down' (front) facing. Only for sprites drawn facing the camera

frameIndex.description: Frame id from get_asset (e.g. an 8-way rotation frame). Omit for the asset's base image

imageIndex.description: Which image of that frame (for a rotation frame: the facing's position in its facings list)

prompt.description: Without a preset: the actions to make, as 'name: description' separated by semicolons. With one: optional extra direction for every clip

name: generate_animation_set
